# Nestbolt

> Local fixed-sheet nesting, MIT. Development groundwork only; no production solver yet.

- [README](README.md): implemented capabilities and development commands.
- [Agent interface](docs/AGENT_INTERFACE.md): native stdio MCP connection and v1 tool contract.
- [Plan](docs/PLAN.md): authoritative scope, gates and milestones; MCP is part of v1.
- [Status](docs/STATUS.md): evidence and remaining work; no completed milestone yet.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): geometry, validator, worker and determinism boundaries.
- [Schemas](schemas/README.md): current inspection formats and future job/result contract.
- [Benchmarks](benchmarks/README.md): frozen integration smoke versus future acceptance runs.
- [Licences](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES): dependency inventory and retained notices.

The MCP binary currently supports connection/initialization only. It exposes no tools.
Do not claim nest, import_parts, validate_layout, export_layout or estimate_sheets work.
The CLI inspect command accepts upstream jagua-rs BPP JSON and requires explicit units.
No source drawings are uploaded. No quality, machine-safety or fit certification is provided.
